methods.comment: * Computes the Window NAF (non-adjacent Form) of an integer. * @param width The width w of the Window NAF. The width is * defined as the minimal number w, such that for any * w consecutive digits in the resulting representation, at * most one is non-zero. * @param k The integer of which the Window NAF is computed. * @return The Window NAF of the given width, such that the following holds: * k = ∑i=0l-1 ki2i * , where the ki denote the elements of the * returned byte[].
